title: README first screen has no image while the Pages demo is unpublished
symptom: Portfolio proof requires an image in the README or a live demo; Pages deploy is an owner action not yet done, so the README is the only 'something to look at' surface and carries no image.
expected: README embeds the cover card (docs/images/portfolio/cover.png, 1000x750) on the first screen.
regression_test: manual: README renders the cover image
root_cause: Cards were rendered for packaging but never embedded in the README; proof's 'something to look at' leg depended entirely on a Pages deploy that is still an owner action.
notes: Same defect exists in deploy-doctor; registered there separately.
